# M&H Boutique Hotel

> A quiet boutique hotel in Kinondo, just outside Diani Beach, Kwale County, Kenya. Studios and 1, 2 and 3 bedroom houses around a swimming pool, with a poolside bar and an all-day restaurant. Founded and run by Margret Mweya. Guests book direct on this website.

## Key facts

- Location: Kinondo ward, Diani, Kwale County, Kenya, near Green Garden Academy. GPS -4.3723307, 39.5253217
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=-4.3723307,39.5253217
- Phone: +254 110 766 432
- Email: mandhboutiquehotel@gmail.com
- Rates per night (USD): Studio with breakfast $80 (up to 2 guests); 1 bedroom house $95; 2 bedroom house $125; 3 bedroom house $155
- Breakfast is included with the studios. Each house has its own kitchen.
- Free for guests: swimming pool, Wi-Fi, parking. Transport available on request.
- Non-guests can swim for KSh 1,000, or free when spending KSh 5,000 at the bar.
- The kitchen is open all day for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The bar serves drinks and cocktails on the terrace.
- Activities arranged by reception: kite surfing, sailing, snorkelling, deep-sea fishing, golf (15 minutes away), safaris, and day trips to Wasini Island and Mombasa Old Town.
